data.name: Backups
data.description: Allows administrators to create Database Backups on a recurring basis. Backups are copied to a remote destination using secure copy over SSH.
changelog: Add Backblaze B2 as a backup destination handler (native B2 API, SHA1-verified uploads, retention support)
Encrypt secret destination credentials (such as the B2 application key) at rest using the panel encryption key
Fix the destination form offering the MySQL Dump source handler as a destination handler
Fix SCP upload failing with "No such file or directory" on OpenSSH 9+ (SFTP-based scp takes the remote path literally)
Bracket IPv6 hosts in the scp target so their colons are not taken as the path separator
Add retention limits: keep the last N backups per recurring backup and/or cap total backups per destination; older backups are pruned automatically, including the remote file
Delete the remote file when a backup archive is deleted
Detect mysqldump failures reliably (pipefail + exit codes) and verify the dump is a valid gzip file before uploading
Include stored routines, events and triggers in database dumps
Keep database credentials out of the process list using a private defaults file
Escape all shell arguments (database name, folders, remote paths)
Harden SSH/SCP: no interactive prompts, connection timeout, host key pinning, IPv6 and host:port support
Fix backups to destinations without a folder configured
Mark backups stuck in progress for over 24 hours as failed
Track backup health per destination so one healthy destination cannot mask a failing one
Clean up temp files after failed backups
Fix recurring backups being skipped when more than 300 are due at once
